# 1. データ読み込み

```{r}
library(survey)
library(srvyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(haven)
library(tidyr)

# オブジェクトクリア
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

# DHSデータのルートフォルダを指定
```

# 2. ヒートマップ作成

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(reshape2)

# spike_yearを先に定義
spike_year <- 2011

# 並べ替えルール用のテーブルを作る
state_order <- endes_keys %>%
  filter(year == spike_year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group_treated = factor(
      group_treated,
      levels = c("treat2_grp", "treat1_grp", "control_grp")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(group_treated, state) %>%
  pull(state)

# summary_by_stateを読み込み
panel_long <- summary_by_state %>%
  dplyr::mutate(year = as.numeric(year)) %>%
  dplyr::select(state, year, variable, value)

# 変数ごとに年対年の変化率を計算
panel_change <- panel_long %>%
  dplyr::group_by(state, variable) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(year) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(pct_change = (value - lag(value)) / lag(value) * 100) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(pct_change),
         !is.infinite(pct_change))

# データ準備
heatmap_data <- panel_change %>%
  dplyr::filter(year == spike_year) %>%
  left_join(endes_keys %>% filter(year == spike_year), 
            by = c("state", "year")) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    group_treated = factor(
      group_treated,
      levels = c("control_grp", "treat1_grp", "treat2_grp")
    ),
    state = factor(state, levels = state_order)
  )

# グループごとの色（お好みで変更）
grp_cols <- c(
  control_grp = "grey30",
  treat1_grp  = "steelblue",
  treat2_grp  = "firebrick"
)

# 州のlevels順に対応したグループを取得
state_group_map <- endes_keys %>%
  dplyr::filter(year == spike_year) %>%
  dplyr::select(state, group_treated) %>%
  distinct()

# levels順に色を並べる
y_cols <- state_group_map %>%
  dplyr::mutate(state = factor(state, levels = levels(heatmap_data$state))) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(state) %>%
  dplyr::pull(group_treated) %>%
  {grp_cols[.]}

# ヒートマップの作成
plot_res <- ggplot(heatmap_data,
                   aes(x = variable, y = state, fill = pct_change)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "white", high = "red",
                       midpoint = 0, limits = c(-100, 100)) +
  theme_minimal() +
  # theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6)) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 6),
    axis.text.y = element_text(colour = y_cols, size = 8)
  ) +
  labs(title = paste("Year-on-Year Change in", spike_year),
       x = "Variables", y = "State", fill = "% Change")


ggsave(plot_res, file = file.path(save_path, "heatmap_spike_year.png"), 
       width = 40, height = 8)

```
# 4. 2011年スパイクの条件で変数を抽出

```{r}

# 1. データ読み込み
library(dplyr)

# summary_vars_by_trtGroupを読み込み
summary_vars_by_trtGroup <- readRDS(
  file.path(save_path, "summary_vars_by_trtGroup_year.rds")
)

# 2. 2011年スパイクで変数抽出
spike_year <- 2011
variables_spike <- summary_vars_by_trtGroup %>%
  filter(year %in% c(spike_year - 1, spike_year, spike_year + 1)) %>%
  group_by(variable, group_treated) %>%
  rename(value = mean_value) %>%
  summarize(
    value_before = value[year == (spike_year - 1)],
    value_spike = value[year == spike_year], 
    value_after = value[year == (spike_year + 1)],
    pct_change_before = (value_spike - value_before) / value_before * 100,
    pct_change_after = (value_after - value_spike) / value_spike * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    spike_yes = case_when(
      pct_change_before >= 5 & pct_change_after <= -5 ~ TRUE,
      pct_change_before <= -5 & pct_change_after >= 5 ~ TRUE,
      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  )

variables_spike_filtered <- variables_spike %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = variable,
    names_from = group_treated,
    values_from = spike_yes
    ) %>%
    mutate(
     sync_spike = ifelse(
       (treat2_grp == TRUE & treat1_grp == TRUE & control_grp == FALSE), TRUE, FALSE
     ) 
    ) %>%
  filter(sync_spike == TRUE)

print(variables_spike_filtered)

print("無事終了しました😊")

```

# 5. 時系列プロット
```{r}
var_set <- list(
  base = list(
    by = c("state", "year"),           # ★ state を含める
    group_by_vars = c("year"),         # ★ 集計は year のみ
    target_var = "nt_ch_stunt",
    labs = list(
      title = "stunting rate by treatment status over years",
      x = "year",
      y = "stunting rate (%)",
      color = "group_treated"
    )
  ),
  allvac = list(
    by = c("state", "year"),
    group_by_vars = c("year"),
    target_var = "ch_allvac_either_Yes",
    labs = list(
      title = "All basic vaccinations according to either source: Yes",
      x = "year",
      y = "All basic vaccinations:Yes",
      color = "group_treated"
    )
  ),
  bcg = list(
    by = c("state", "year"),
    group_by_vars = c("year"),
    target_var = "ch_bcg_either_Yes",
    labs = list(
      title = "BCG vaccination according to either source: Yes",
      x = "year",
      y = "BCG vaccinations:Yes",
      color = "group_treated"
    )
  ),
  ane_wom = list(
    by = c("state", "year"),
    group_by_vars = c("year"),
    target_var = "nt_wm_any_anem_Yes",
    labs = list(
      title = "Any anemia - women: Yes",
      x = "year",
      y = "Any anemia - women: Yes",
      color = "group_treated"
    )
  )
)

# summary_by_trtGroupを読み込み
panel_graph <- readRDS(
  file.path(save_path, "summary_vars_by_trtGroup_year.rds")
  ) %>% 
  rename(value = mean_value)

# プロット作成
res_map <- purrr::map(var_set, ~ { # map関数で変数セットに対して繰り返し。実行結果はリスト化
  by_vars <- .x$by
  group_by_vars <- .x$group_by_vars # ★ 追加
  target_var <- .x$target_var
  labs_var <- .x$labs

  plot_data <- panel_graph %>%
    filter(variable %in% target_var)

  plot_res <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(
    x = year, y = value,
    color = group_treated,
    group = group_treated
  )) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    do.call(labs, labs_var) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")

  return(plot_res)
})

saveRDS(res_map, file = file.path(save_path, "plot_year_treaatmentGrp.rds"))

stop("無事終了しました😊")

#' ****************************************************************************
# グラフをpdf出力(必要に応じて)
#' ****************************************************************************
library(gridExtra)
library(grid)

# 余白の調整
plots2 <- lapply(res_map, function(p){
  p + theme(plot.margin = unit(c(0.8, 0.8, 0.8, 0.8), "cm"))
})

# 2x3のレイアウトでPDF出力
g <- marrangeGrob(plots2, nrow = 3, ncol = 2)

# ggplot2で保存
ggsave("plots_2x3_marginWide.pdf",
       g, width = 11.7, height = 8.3, units = "in")

print("pdf出力しました😊")

```
